subject: angol
title: Join a club this term!
instructions: Read the descriptions of five after-school clubs (A–E). Which club do the statements (1–9) refer to? Write the correct letter. You can use the letters more than once. There is an example (0) at the beginning.
instructionsHu: Olvasd el öt iskolai szakkör leírását (A–E), és döntsd el, melyik szakkörre vonatkoznak az állítások (1–9). Egy betűt többször is használhatsz. A 0. a példa.

passage.title: Join a club this term!
passage.subtitle: After-school clubs at our school – sign up at the school office by 30 September

blocks.heading: A – Robotics Club
blocks.text: Do you like building things and solving problems? In the Robotics Club, you work in teams of three to build and program small robots. No experience is needed – older members will teach you the basics. We meet every Tuesday from 3.30 to 5 pm in the computer room. In March, we take part in an international competition in Vienna, and the school pays for the trip. Please note: places are limited to 18 students, so sign up early!

blocks.heading: B – Drama Club
blocks.text: If you love acting – or if you are shy and want to become more confident – the Drama Club is for you. We play drama games, write short scenes and, at the end of the year, put on a full play for parents and friends. Not everyone has to be on stage: we also need people to help with lights, music and costumes. We meet on Wednesdays and Fridays after the last lesson in the school hall.

blocks.heading: C – Eco Club
blocks.text: The Eco Club wants to make our school greener. Last year, we started a recycling system in every classroom and planted thirty trees behind the sports field. This year, we are going to build a vegetable garden, and the vegetables we grow will be used in the school canteen. We meet every Monday at lunchtime, so you don't have to stay after school. Bring your own sandwiches!

blocks.heading: D – Debate Club
blocks.text: Do you enjoy arguing with your friends? Then turn it into a skill! In the Debate Club, you will learn how to speak in public, find strong arguments and listen to the other side. All our debates are in English, so the club is also great practice for your language exams. We meet on Thursdays from 4 to 5.30 pm. Members must come to at least three meetings a month.

blocks.heading: E – Photography Club
blocks.text: You don't need an expensive camera to take great photos – a phone is enough. In our club, you will learn about light, composition and editing. Once a month we go on a photo walk around the town, usually on a Saturday morning. The best photos are shown at an exhibition in the school library in May. Membership costs 2,000 forints a term, which pays for printing the photos.

example.prompt: This club meets during the lunch break.
example.explanation: Az Eco Club hétfőnként ebédidőben találkozik („at lunchtime”), ezért nem kell iskola után maradni – C.
example.evidence: We meet every Monday at lunchtime

items.prompt: Members can travel to another city for a competition.
items.explanation: A Robotics Club márciusban egy nemzetközi versenyen vesz részt Bécsben, és az utat az iskola fizeti – A.
items.evidence: In March, we take part in an international competition in Vienna

wrongOptions.E: A fotósok is elmennek fotósétára, de csak a saját városban („around the town”), és nem versenyre.

items.evidence: Not everyone has to be on stage: we also need people to help with lights, music and costumes.

wrongOptions.D: A vitakörben nyilvánosan kell beszélni, de ott nincs színdarab, és nincs szó segítőkről, akik nem szerepelnek.

items.explanation: A Debate Club minden vitája angol nyelvű, ezért jó gyakorlás a nyelvvizsgákra – D.

items.explanation: A Photography Club tagsága félévente 2000 forint, ebből fizetik a fényképek nyomtatását – E.

items.explanation: A Robotics Clubban legfeljebb 18 diák lehet („places are limited to 18 students”), ezért érdemes korán jelentkezni – A.

wrongOptions.D: A Debate Clubnál a minimális részvétel van megszabva (legalább három alkalom havonta), nem a létszám.

items.explanation: A Photography Club havonta fotósétára megy, általában szombat délelőtt – ez hétvége, tehát E.

items.explanation: A Debate Club tagjainak havonta legalább három foglalkozáson részt kell venniük – D.
